title: Census sessions read pages that refuse a bare request, long documents and vanished MicrosoftDocs pins
goal: python3 _tools/fetch.py text URL --grep PATTERN prints only the lines of the fetched text that match, so a census session reads a long document without a pipe; census.fetch_argv sends every page url through fetch.py text, which sends the kb User-Agent and reads a PDF or archive by its bytes, with a url's quotes and spaces percent-encoded so its rule names it exactly; census.read_commands gives a MicrosoftDocs pin whose census clone is missing the line that re-sources it to its live Learn page; each dispatched session's fetch rule allows the fetch.py text options after its url

import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census
bad = []
for u in ('https://example.org/page.html', 'https://prices.example.org/api?$filter=contains(productName,\'Defender for\')'):
    a = census.fetch_argv(u)
    if a[:3] != ['python3', '_tools/fetch.py', 'text'] or "'" in a[-1] or ' ' in a[-1]:
        bad.append(('fetch_argv', u, a))
pin = 'a' * 40
r = dict(kind='raw-pin', repo='github.com/MicrosoftDocs/zz-gone-repo', pin=pin, path='articles/x.md', evidence='', proof='', note='',
         url='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MicrosoftDocs/zz-gone-repo/%s/articles/x.md' % pin)
lines = census.read_commands(r, {'providers': {}})
if not any('Learn' in l for l in lines):
    bad.append(('read_commands of a MicrosoftDocs pin with no clone', lines))
plan = {'files': [], 'git': [], 'fetch': {'S1': census.fetch_argv('https://example.org/long.pdf')}, 'learn': []}
allow, _ = census.dispatch_rules(plan, '/tmp/zz-scratch')
rule = [a for a in allow if 'fetch.py' in a and 'kbid.py' not in a]
if not rule or not all(a.endswith(' *)') for a in rule):
    bad.append(('dispatch_rules fetch rule does not allow options after the url', rule))
print(len(bad), 'census route failures:', bad)
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

gates.question: How does a dispatched session's fetch rule allow the fetch.py text options after the url, and how is a MicrosoftDocs pin row with no census clone re-sourced?
options: The Bash rule is the exact fetch_argv line followed by ' *'; a second brief line NO_CLONE_LINE (any MicrosoftDocs repository whose clone directory is missing, not only a row noted memdocs) sends the reader to the Learn tool, and dispatch_plan treats it like MEMDOCS_LINE
Rule stays exact and the session may not add options; the memdocs line wording is reused for every missing clone

notes: Operator 2026-10-22: second pass on the 116 cited sources the widened rerun of ST-bjwyl2bc left unconfirmed (90 of 206 settled, $13.79). Measured on this host 2026-10-22: techcommunity.microsoft.com answers 403 to curl with no User-Agent and 200 with 'it-ops-kb census' (13 sources); crates.io API 403 without, 200 with a User-Agent (17); cisecurity.org 200 with one; arXiv /pdf/ID urls serve application/pdf with no .pdf suffix, which fetch_argv sends to curl (8); fetch.py text already reads such a PDF by its bytes. Sessions piped curl output to head or grep and were denied, so long documents were read in part (about 10); urls with quotes or spaces (prices.azure.com, PowerShell Gallery OData, MSRC API) got no rule (about 6). github.com/MicrosoftDocs/memdocs and azure-ai-docs now answer 404 (repo page and raw files), so census.repo_dir fails to clone them and their 8 pin rows have no route; MEMDOCS_LINE covers only rows noted memdocs at check time. Premise on origin/main of 2026-10-22: check 0 exits 1 (fetch.py text has no --grep), check 1 exits 1 (fetch_argv gives curl; read_commands gives git lines only). Clause 4 is read by no check: the worker adds a dispatch_rules assertion to check 1 if the rule's form allows it. Out of scope: EUR-Lex, PyPI and npm bot challenges, JavaScript-only pages, .wiki.git remotes. Planning 2026-10-22: check 1 now also reads clause 4 through census.dispatch_rules on a planted plan (the fetch rule must end in " *)", as the kbid.py url rule does).
